verdict.rationale: Porkbun connects domains to its own hosting end to end: it can provision Static Hosting or Cloud for WordPress on a domain and serve it over HTTPS. It also offers a guided handoff of DNS to the customer's own Cloudflare account, and its MCP server can handle requests like "point it at my server" in plain language. Beyond that, connecting to an external host means hand-editing DNS records via generic CRUD. Missing for 10: DNS templates or one-click connect for major third-party hosts (e.g., Vercel, Netlify, Shopify, Squarespace, GitHub Pages), a documented guided dashboard connect flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
